1. Anton checks the cups in person and reports the number he can account for If they’re spread across more than one spot, he includes each location and subtotal The expected figure of 38 is only a reference point until that check is done, so please don’t copy it into the inventory as a confirmed result beforehand If any cups are difficult to identify as part of this batch, Anton can flag those separately rather than making an uncertain judgment on the total

3. Only when the count has been checked and the placement has been confirmed should anyone move the cups or change the shared inventory The inventory update should include the verified number and the actual location, not just the expected total If the physical count differs from 38, record what Anton found and leave the discrepancy visible until we’ve worked out whether pieces are elsewhere or the original estimate was off
